description: Intelligent Gmail operations with automatic confirmation for expensive operations. These tools analyze email complexity BEFORE fetching full content and request user confirmation when needed.

tools.name: gmail_analyze_email_smart
tools.description:
SMART email analysis with automatic user confirmation for large/expensive content.

This is the RECOMMENDED way to read emails. It:
1. Checks email size and attachments first (lightweight)
2. Requests user confirmation if content is large (>10k tokens)
3. Returns parsed content directly if small

USE THIS when user asks to:
- 'Read my email'
- 'What does this email say?'
- 'Analyze email from X'

The tool will handle confirmation automatically via multi-turn conversation.

returns.description: Either parsed email content OR confirmation request

properties.status: string ('confirmation_required' if large, omitted if small)

tools.name: gmail_analyze_thread_smart
tools.description:
SMART thread analysis with automatic confirmation for large threads.

This tool:
1. Fetches thread timeline first (lightweight)
2. Analyzes complexity (message count, attachments)
3. Requests confirmation if thread is large (>5 messages or >10k tokens)
4. Returns timeline directly if small

USE THIS when user asks to:
- 'Show me the conversation about X'
- 'What's this email thread about?'
- 'Read the email chain'

The tool handles confirmation via multi-turn conversation.

returns.description: Either thread timeline OR confirmation request

tools.name: gmail_search_smart
tools.description:
SMART search with intelligent result analysis and suggestions.

This tool:
1. Performs Gmail search
2. Analyzes result complexity
3. Provides intelligent next-step suggestions
4. Helps user navigate large result sets

USE THIS when user asks to:
- 'Search for emails about X'
- 'Find messages from Y'
- 'Show emails with attachment Z'

Returns results plus suggestions for next actions.

query.description: Gmail search query (same syntax as Gmail search box)
